title: Ampleness restricts to closed subschemes
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $M$ be an ample invertible $\mathcal O_Y$-module [def-sc-invertible-module, def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]. For every closed immersion $i:X\to Y$ [def-weil-closed-immersion], the pullback $i^*M$ [def-pc-module-pullback] is ample on $X$ [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module].

source.place: Tag 01PU (lemma-ample-on-closed): restriction of an ample invertible sheaf to any closed subscheme is ample.
